evidence.reason: `git ls-tree --name-only` C-quotes unusual pathnames by default (core.quotePath=true), so a tracked file whose path contains non-ASCII bytes, tabs, quotes, or newlines is emitted in quoted form. The comparison `stdout.split('\n').includes(rel)` therefore never matches, and `deletedAtHead` incorrectly rejects a valid tracked deletion. Using `-z` and splitting on `\0` is the correct fix.
